name: Arista Networks (ANET)
teaser: Do not add. Arista grew revenue 58.5% and the stock fell 21% from its October high, but $170.80 still equals my Bull case; Base $129.15, buy zone $74.26.
llms: Arista Networks (ANET), listed on the NYSE, sells Ethernet switches and the EOS operating system for cloud, AI and campus networks; two customers bought 42% of 2025 revenue. Valued with a ten-year free cash flow model with stock pay as a cost and a forward EV/EBIT cross-check on 2028. Third quarter 2026 revenue rose 58.5% to $3.66 billion and management guides about $18.5 billion for 2027; the price implies revenue about 37% above my Base every year, roughly my Bull case. Bear $62.71, Base $129.15, Bull $170.38. Verdict Hold at $170.80 (November 6, 2026 NYSE close), do not add, maximum buy price $74.26.
